harnessDedupConsequence.whyThisIsCorrect: The harness dedups on (section ref + sha256 of the exact operative bytes) and its stated rule is that duplicates are candidates for which 'compiling one is provably equivalent to compiling the other'. These two pairs share an anchor and differ only in discovered ROLE - and role never reaches SemanticCompilerInput (verified at the call site), so the compiler input differs only in candidateRef. Previously they looked distinct only because one member had its parent section appended. Nothing is silently lost: the dedup report records the kept/dropped mapping for both pairs.
